notes:
V3.1.9 — three fixes from the latest report.

🛡  CRASH FIX — adding a custom bot whose 'side' isn't one of the three built-ins (LONG/SHORT/DAY) no longer crashes with KeyError: 'crypto' (or whatever you named it). BotTab now falls back to the colour the user picked when they imported the bot, and resolves the script path defensively (handles .py ↔ .apex lock toggling too).

🚨  GLOBAL EXCEPTION HANDLER — any unhandled Python exception now pops a friendly QMessageBox with the short error + a 'Detailed text' button containing the full traceback. The full trace is also appended to DATA_DIR/apex_crash.log so it survives across sessions. The app keeps running afterwards instead of silently exiting.

🔑  PER-PROVIDER API KEY MEMORY — switching the MAKE BOT provider from Anthropic to Gemini back to Anthropic now restores each one's saved key from apex_settings.json. No more re-pasting every time you change providers. Saved automatically on every edit.

NOT IN THIS BUILD (but coming):
• Centralised key generation on the APEX server. The 'Via APEX' provider currently only routes Claude — extending it to also proxy Gemini and Groq from server-side keys (so users never touch keys at all) needs a few server endpoints + credit-cost configuration. Will land as v3.2.0.
